Those three edges directly connect the candidate to both the mechanism and the target, providing a coherent causal path by which Chile activity could precede and import infections that raise US hospitalizations. The other candidates lack one of these links (Australia has no IMPORTATION_LINK; Travel Importation Pressure lacks the LEADING_INDICATOR_FOR link to the target) and have lower scores, making them less plausible given the provided evidence.
